records.text: HSTEU 477 From 13 Colonies to Brexit: Making and Un-Making of the British Empire (5) SSc, DIV Explores history of British empire from the American Revolution to the recent Brexit vote, focusing on role of empire in fostering connection, oppression, and anti-colonial resistance. Considers what life was like for British citizens and subjects around the world, paying particular attention to shifting definitions of Britishness over time.
